instruction.name: movfr2cf
instruction.description: Move the low bit of fj into condition code cd.

experiments.name: condition-code dependency chain
experiments.notes: Round trip between movcf2fr/movfr2cf or movcf2gr/movgr2cf is 2 cycles. The split is consistent with the fcmp chains: CF->FPR=1, FPR->CF=1, CF->GPR=3, GPR->CF=1.

latencies.notes: Round trip between movcf2fr/movfr2cf or movcf2gr/movgr2cf is 2 cycles. The split is consistent with the fcmp chains: CF->FPR=1, FPR->CF=1, CF->GPR=3, GPR->CF=1.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movfr2cf $fcc0, $f0; movfr2cf $fcc1, $f1; movfr2cf $fcc2, $f2; movfr2cf $fcc3, $f3; movfr2cf $fcc4, $f4; movfr2cf $fcc5, $f5; movfr2cf $fcc6, $f6; movfr2cf $fcc7, $f7
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f8, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f9, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f10, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f11, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f12, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f13, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f14, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f15, $r4' --asm 'movfr2cf $fcc0, $f0; movfr2cf $fcc1, $f1; movfr2cf $fcc2, $f2; movfr2cf $fcc3, $f3; movfr2cf $fcc4, $f4; movfr2cf $fcc5, $f5; movfr2cf $fcc6, $f6; movfr2cf $fcc7, $f7'

notes: Round trip between movcf2fr/movfr2cf or movcf2gr/movgr2cf is 2 cycles. The split is consistent with the fcmp chains: CF->FPR=1, FPR->CF=1, CF->GPR=3, GPR->CF=1. Throughput is 1 CPI for movcf2gr/movgr2cf and 0.5 CPI for movcf2fr/movfr2cf.
